signature: SUBROUTINE DSFRK( TRANSR, UPLO, TRANS, N, K, ALPHA, A, LDA, BETA,

params.name: transr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: The Normal Form of RFP A is stored;
-   `= 'T'`: The Transpose Form of RFP A is stored.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
On entry, `UPLO` specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the array C is to be referenced as follows:

`UPLO = 'U'` or 'u' Only the upper triangular part of C

is to be referenced.

`UPLO = 'L'` or 'l' Only the lower triangular part of C

is to be referenced.

Unchanged on exit.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANS` specifies the operation to be performed as follows:

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'N'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'n'} C := \alpha \, A \, A^T + \beta \, C
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANS} = \text{'T'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'t'} C := \alpha \, A^T \, A + \beta \, C
$$

Unchanged on exit.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the order of the matrix C. N must be at least zero. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: K
params.reference: On entry with `TRANS = 'N'` or 'n', K specifies the number of columns of the matrix A, and on entry with `TRANS = 'T'` or 't', K specifies the number of rows of the matrix A. K must be at least zero. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: On entry, `ALPHA` specifies the scalar $\alpha$. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: A
params.reference: where KA is K when `TRANS = 'N'` or 'n', and is N otherwise. Before entry with `TRANS = 'N'` or 'n', the leading N--by--K part of the array A must contain the matrix A, otherwise the leading K--by--N part of the array A must contain the matrix A. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: lda
params.reference: On entry, `LDA` specifies the first dimension of A as declared in the calling (sub) program. When `TRANS = 'N'` or 'n' then `LDA` must be at least max( 1, n ), otherwise `LDA` must be at least max( 1, k ). Unchanged on exit.

params.name: beta
params.reference: On entry, `BETA` specifies the scalar $\beta$. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: c
params.reference: $\mathrm{NT} = N \, (N+1)/2$. On entry, the symmetric matrix C in RFP Format. RFP Format is described by `TRANSR`, `UPLO` and N.
